summary: Run again or step aside: Your numbers are low, the next race is a year off, and {close tie} asks whether you want another term.
realLife: One life: With her popularity down after Hurricane Katrina, she announced in 2007 that she would not seek re-election as Louisiana governor. Bobby Jindal, whom she had beaten in 2003, succeeded her. Another: With polls showing few voters thought he deserved re-election, he announced his retirement in 2011. Another: He did not seek a second Senate term and backed a successor who lost the seat.
gates: You hold an office and could run again.
weights: What you still want to do.
choices: announce you will not run, and govern

branches.then: You spend the rest of the term governing, and the rival you beat years ago takes the office after you.

branches.when: a poll says few think you deserve another term
branches.then: You retire, and your farewell speech is the last record of your time.
{chosen successor} loses, and the seat goes to the other party.
